title: The oldest café in town
summary_es: Una cafetería de toda la vida. Pasado simple, conectores, cuantificadores y preposiciones de tiempo.
text: The Blue Door is the oldest café in our town. It {{1}} in 1950, and the same family still owns it. People come here {{2}} they love the home-made cakes. The café is very small. There are {{3}} six tables, so you often have to wait. Mrs Reed, the owner, knows {{4}} of her customers by name. She gets up at five o'clock every morning to {{5}} the bread. The café is closed on Mondays, but it is open {{6}} nine to five on the other days.

gaps.explanation_es: Un negocio «abre»: it opened in 1950. «Built» necesitaría la pasiva (it was built).
Da la razón: because = porque. «So» introduce la consecuencia, no la causa.
«Only six tables» = solo seis mesas. «Much» es para incontables y «any», para preguntas y negativas.
«Most of her customers» = la mayoría de sus clientes. «Every» no puede ir seguido de of.
La comida se «hace» con make: make bread, make a cake, make dinner.
«From nine to five» = de nueve a cinco. «Between» iría con and: between nine and five.
